in_arabic.name: هاشمي
in_arabic.meaning: يَرمزُ إلى العَلاقة بِالنبي محمد ﷺ، وَهُوَ تَكريمٌ لِلمُؤمنين
in_arabic.long_meaning: يَنسبُ هاشمي إلى النبي محمد ﷺ، وَهُوَ أَسمٌ عَظيم الشُرف وَالقِدرة، يُرمزُ إلى العَلاقة بِالنبي محمد ﷺ، وَهُوَ تَكريمٌ لِلمُؤمنين، وَيَدلُ على حبّ الخَير وَالسَّلامة، وَهُوَ أَسمٌ نافع في الإسلام، وَيُعتبرُ إحدى أَسَماءِ النبي محمد ﷺ، وَهُوَ يُشيرُ إلى العَلاقة البَيِّنة بِالنبي محمد ﷺ، وَهُوَ يَحملُ المعني السَالم وَالخَير، وَمما يُعتبر شَرفًا لِلمُؤمنين، وَيَدلُ على الإيمان وَالتوحيد

in_urdu.name: ھاشمی
in_urdu.meaning: نبی محمد ﷺ سے تعلق کا نام ہے، اور یہ مومنین کے لئے ایک تعظیم ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ھاشمی نام نبی محمد ﷺ سے تعلق کا نام ہے، اور یہ مومنین کے لئے ایک تعظیم ہے، یہ نام خیر و سلامتی کا نام ہے، اور مومنین کے لئے یہ نام نافع ہے، یہ نام ایک شرف ہے جو مومنین کو عطا کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام ایک اعزاز ہے جو مومنین کے لئے ہے، اور یہ نام ایک تعلیم ہے جو مومنین کو پڑھائی جاتی ہے، اور یہ نام ایک یادگار ہے جو مومنین کو یاد کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हाशमी
in_hindi.meaning: नबी मुहम्मद से परिचिति का नाम है, और यह मुस्लिमों के लिए एक सम्मान है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हाशमी नाम नबी मुहम्मद से परिचिति का नाम है, और यह मुस्लिमों के लिए एक सम्मान है, यह नाम खुशी और सौभाग्य का नाम है, और मुस्लिमों के लिए यह नाम उपयोगी है, यह एक सम्मान है जो मुस्लिमों को दिया जाता है, और यह एक गर्व है जो मुस्लिमों के लिए है, और यह एक शिक्षा है जो मुस्लिमों को पढ़ाई जाती है, और यह एक यादगार है जो मुस्लिमों को याद किया जाता है

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Hashimi' holds a rich cultural heritage in the Islamic world. It is associated with the Hashemite Dynasty, one of the oldest dynasties in the Middle East, tracing its roots back to Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) uncle, Ali ibn Abi Talib, and his son, Husain ibn Ali. Hashimid rule extended across various regions, including modern-day Iraq, Jordan, Yemen, and Morocco. This name invokes pride in history and a sense of connection to the Islamic Golden Age, a period of enlightenment marked by scientific, artistic, and cultural achievements.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Hashimi' holds a deeper spiritual significance in the context of its noble origins. The Hashemite lineage is a reminder of noble leadership and valor, even during the most challenging circumstances. It is a name that encourages strength, resilience, and unwavering commitment to one's beliefs. Moreover, the Hashemite dynasty was known for upholding the righteous caliphs, and the name 'Hashimi' carries the legacy of this spiritual lineage. It resonates with spiritual growth, as it calls its bearers to embody the noble qualities of leadership and maintaining strong moral values, as inspired by their historical namesakes.

historical_references.reference: The Hashimid Caliphate, also known as the Fatimid Caliphate, was a Shia Islamic state that existed from 909 to 1171 AD. The dynasty was named after its founders, the Hashimid family of Mecca, who claimed descent from the Prophet Muhammad through his uncle, Ali.
historical_references.context: The Hashimids established their caliphate in North Africa and later in Egypt, becoming a major power in the Mediterranean world. They introduced the Ismaili doctrine of Shia Islam, which emphasized the importance of a hidden imam and the role of the caliph as his representative on earth.

historical_references.reference: The Hashimid dynasty traces its origins to the tribe of Hashim, which was one of the prominent clans of the Quraish tribe in Mecca during the time of the Prophet Muhammad. The Hashimids were the custodians of the Kaaba, the holiest site in Islam, and were also the guardians of the Islamic pilgrimage routes.
historical_references.context: The Hashimid dynasty's significance grew during the early Islamic period as they played an important role in the political and religious life of Mecca. They were also the ancestors of the Prophet Muhammad's uncle, Ali, and later became the founders of the Fatimid Caliphate.
